title: How do your social media numbers translate to Steam stats?
author: Former_Ebb_3194
selftext:
I'm working on my first indie game and trying to set realistic expectations before launch. For those who've released a game on Steam, how did your numbers compare across platforms?

\- Social media followers/views (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.)

\- Steam wishlists before launch

\- Actual sales after launch

\- Reviews received

Even rough numbers or ranges would be helpful. I know every game is different, but I'd like to understand typical conversion rates and avoid setting unrealistic expectations or getting disappointed later.

comments.author: AfterBedtimeGames
comments.body: I'm on the same path as you, so I would love to see what others say about this! I'm also releasing on Steam at some point, but I know a lot of Switch players also play that genre (cozy).
